;; WILDCARD happy path: `*` is the effective wildcard, so `?` is an
;; ordinary literal board character (here, a crate the player swaps with).
;; The move rule uses `*` in both roles: source match-any and destination
;; preserve. The goal pattern contains a literal `?`.

WILDCARD *

TITLE Wildcard fixture

GOAL
1?

?-1

BIND a move_w "west"

CMD move_w
 ?1* 1?*

 -1 1-
